title: Actual scheme pullback and its proper/open clopen section
statement: def canonicalShape {T : Scheme} {X Y Z : Over T} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (j₁ : X ⟶ Y) (j₂ : X ⟶ Z) [IsProper f.left] [IsOpenImmersion j₁.left] [IsOpenImmersion j₂.left] (h : j₁ ≫ f = j₂) : Shape f j₁ j₂

source.place: 6.7.6–6.7.7, compactification independence; agent ordinary-derived ring-sheaf coefficient supplement to the clopen-section refinement construction, not a theorem literally asserted in the paper.

proof.text: Form the actual scheme pullback and lift its projections to Over T. The canonical section has both projection identities by the pullback universal property. Apply properOpenSectionProperties to give the open and clopen fields. Construct the pullback cone in Over T and prove uniqueness by pullback.hom_ext.
